A student conducted a photoelectric effect experiment by shining light of various wavelengths onto a metal surface. To stop the flow of photocurrent, the student applied a negative potential until the current dropped to zero. The following readings were recorded. Are these readings valid? Provide justification for your answer.

| Wavelength (nm) | Stopping Potential (V) |
|---|---:|
| 400 | 1.71 |
| 450 | 1.08 |
| 500 | 0.86 |
| 550 | 1.36 |
